'''Ganzik''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TUR" /> located in the [[Ganzik system/Legends|Ganzik system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated near the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The primary [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing company [[Mesens Corporation]] were located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Ganzik.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ganzik was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Ganzik [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ganzik itself, in grid square R-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
